fr_epicer_verb.why: The respelling must not read as pee.

fr_farcir_verb.why: She holds the mirror for se farcir.

fr_saurer_verb.en: to smoke fish or meat in a chimney
ex: Il saure les harengs dans la cheminée.
He smokes the herrings in the chimney.
fr_saurer_verb.why: The stock gloss says smoke; the chimney keeps it food-smoking, not tobacco.
